outcome: Need for medical and surgical intervention
cohort: 100 primigravida women with unengaged fetal head at term and at the onset of labor
finding: The study observed that a high head at term in primigravida was associated with a higher cesarean section rate (41%), and various factors like deflexed head and induction of labor influenced labor progress and outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 41% of the cases.
